description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans clustering membership table implementation using Redis as the backend store. It defines a test class RedisMembershipTableTests that inherits from a base test class and includes various test methods for operations like get gateways, read all entries, insert, update, and cleanup functions.

classes.name: RedisMembershipTableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for Redis-backed Orleans membership table operations, including setup using connection options, and tests verifying gateway retrieval, insertion, reading, updating, and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates and initializes a Redis-based membership table instance with specified options, used for testing membership operations.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates a Redis gateway list provider using the membership table for testing gateway-related functionalities.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Asynchronously returns the Redis connection string from test configuration.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Test method to verify retrieval of gateway endpoints from membership table.

methods.name: ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Test method to verify reading all entries from an empty membership table.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Test method to verify inserting a membership record into the table.

methods.name: ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Test method for inserting a row and reading it back to verify correctness.

methods.name: ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Test method for inserting multiple records and reading all entries.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Test method to verify updating an existing membership record.

methods.name: UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Test method to verify concurrent updates on the membership table.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Test method to verify updating the 'I am alive' timestamp for a silo entry.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Test method to verify cleanup of defunct silo entries from the table.
